name: tsukuyomi
description: Tsukuyomi (formerly KaguyaPi) — a Grok Build-style agent TUI with OpenCode-style workspace panels and multi-provider sign-in, powered by the Pi coding-agent kernel.

scripts.check: node --check bin/tsukuyomi.mjs && node --check bin/kaguyapi.mjs && for file in app/*.mjs app/providers/*.mjs app/providers/config/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit $?; done
